all_quotes.quote: EPIC 204278916 has been serendipitously discovered from its *K2* light curve which displays irregular dimmings of up to $65\%$ for $\approx$25 consecutive days out of 78.8 days of observations.

We examine the *K2* light curve in detail and hypothesise that the irregular dimmings are caused by either a warped inner-disk edge or transiting cometary-like objects in either circular or eccentric orbits.
